# gigahost_ssh_keys (Data Source)

Returns all SSH keys on the account — for wiring keys created outside Terraform into `gigahost_server.ssh_keys` via `id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All SSH keys on the account.
data "gigahost_ssh_keys" "all" {}

output "ssh_key_ids" {
  value = [for k in data.gigahost_ssh_keys.all.keys : k.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `keys` (Attributes List) The account's SSH keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `added_at` (Number) When the key was added (Unix seconds).
- `id` (String) Unique identifier.
- `name` (String) Key name as registered on the account.
- `public_key` (String) The SSH public key in `authorized_keys` form.
